Aynal Haque @ Aynal.
Vs. 
The State
full_judgment:
S.M. Mozibur Rahman, .J: On an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, the Rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the impugned judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 20.01.2013 passed by the learned Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal No. 02, Manikganj in Nari-O-Shishu Case No. 231 of 2004 arising out of G.R. Case No. 157 of 2004 corresponding to Singair Police Station Case No. 31 dated 28.06.2004 convicting the petitioner under Section 9( 1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 and sentencing him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk. 20,000/- only in default to suffer simple imprisonment for 06(six) months more should not be quashed and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this court may seem fit and proper. 

 2. Short facts necessary for disposal of the Rule, are that one Mrs. Tahmina @ Jonaki. a girl of 18 years lodged a First Information Report with the Singair Police Station, Manikganj on 28.06.2004 under Section 9(1)/30 of the Nari-O-Sh ishu Nirjaton Damon Ain, 2000 against the petitioner and 4 others alleging inter alia that she was married with one Jasim Uddin of her same village. Her husband went to Saudi Arab three months after their wedding ceremony for livelihood in abroad. So she had to live in her mother's house and sometimes she used to stay in the house or her father-in-law also. In this circumstances, the convict accused petitioner Aynal Haque as neighbour of the informant's house proposed to make an illicit relationship with her. Having been failed to commit these evil deeds, the accused petitioner at one stage proposed to marry her. This matter was brought to the knowledge of the petitioners uncle Dr. Masud and Mokim by the informant but they did not take any action against the accused petitioner. On 09.12.2003 hearing the news of ailment, the mother of the informant went to her elder sister's house leaving the informant alone in her house. Then taking the opportunity of loneliness of the victim Jonaki, the accused Aynal came to her house at about 11.00 p.m. night and requested her to open the door stating that there is a news of her mother's sickness. So, the victim Jonaki opened the door presuming that her mother might be sicked when the accused petitioner rapidly entered into her room and attempted to commit rape on her. But despite of strong resistance of the victim, at one stage, the accused petitioner putting her in fear of instant death showing his dagger committed rape on her and threatened her not to disclose the incident to any body else. Since the informant was married, she thought her conjugal life might be miserable if she discloses the matter at that moment except her mother who ultimately makes it know to all respectable persons of the locality and moved unsuccessfully door to door of them for securing justice. But 2/3 months after the occurrence, the victim Jonaki understood that she has been conceived due to rape committed on her. Then she disclosed the matter to the accused Aynal Hoque and his guardians, the accused Nos. 2-5 who tried to miscarriage her baby by abortion. Subsequently, the matter was brought to the knowledge of the local Member and Chairman. Her mother also disclosed the incident to the local witnesses of the case who assured her to settle the matter by holding a local Salish. But the incident was not solved due to non cooperation of the accused petitioner. In this way, she became pregnant for a period of 06(six) months and 16 days. The informant lastly stated that delay to lodge the F.I.R. was caused as the guardian of the accused petitioner gave false assurance of compromising the matter locally. Hence the case. 

 3. It may be noted here that during investigation of this case the victim was examined by medical officer, Manikganj Adhunik Sadar Hospital, Manikganj wherefrom a certificate was issued stating that the victim is a girl of 18 years old who was bearing 29 weeks pregnancy. 

 4. After concluding Police Investigation Charge Sheet being No. 117 dated 31.07.2004 was submitted against the accused petitioner under section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Damon Ain, 2000. The learned Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Damon Tribunal, Manikganj after taking cognizance of the offence, framed charge under section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Damon Ain, 2000 against the convict accused. But the charge so framed could not be read over and explained to the accused as he was fugitive at the time of framing charge. In the mean time, the accused petitioner left Bangladesh for Malaysia for which the whole trial of the case was concluded in absentia. But he was duly defended by the state defence lawyer during trial of the case. 

 6. Thereafter, the accused petitioner surrendered before the trial Court on 09.07.2015 and filed the instant quashment petition on 30.07.2015. But at the time of hearing of this case it was unveiled that record of the lower Court is lying with another quashment petition being Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 which was also filed by this accused petitioner and Rule was issued in that case on 23.01.2014 before filing the instant quashment petition showing the date of his surrender, on 24.09.2013. As a result, we have examined the record of Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 and found that in the name of convict accused Aynal Haque earlier Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 was filed. While we asked about how this accused petitioner filed two cases on the self same matter showing two separate date of surrender as mentioned above, the learned Advocate for the accused petitioner Mr. Golam Kibria replied that he knows nothing about the earlier Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014. On perusal of that record it is found that the case was filed on behalf of the accused petitioner by another learned Advocate Mr. Abdul Kader Bhuiyan. Accordingly, we asked Mr. Bhuiyan to appear before this court at the time of hearing of these cases. Subsequently, Mr. Bhuiyan, learned Advocate for the petitioner of Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 appearing before this Court stated that after filing the quashment petition though he obtained Rule but failed to release the convict accused Aynal Haque on ad-interim bail. While asked as to why the two cases were instituted by one convict accused, Mr. Bhuiyan failed to state the real fact of the case. On perusal of the record of these two cases, we have detected that Aynal Haque of Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 surrendered on 24.09.2013 and Aynal Haque of this quashment petition surrendered on 09.07.2015 as accused of the same case which give rise to a clumsy situation in disposing of the matter. At last, on perusal of the lower Court's record and all other relevant papers, we succeeded to reveal that this convict petitioner of the instant quashment petition coming back from alaysia to Bangladesh managed one Arif Khan son of Aroj Khan of Village Chak Palpara, Police Station, Singair, Manikgonj giving him false assurance that Arif Khan would be taken to Malayisa if he surrender before the learned Judge of the Tribunal in place of the accused petitioner of this quashment petition. The said Arif Khan was also assured that he would be released on bail by any means and thereafter he would be sent to Malaysia. Having been allured by the false assurance of the convict accused Aynal Hoque, above noted Arif Khan surrendered before the Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Tribunal, Manikgonj introducing himself as convict accused Aynal Hoque on 24.09.2013 and thereafter this convict accused filed a quashment petition on 09.01.2014 being Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 and prayed for bail. But his bail petition was refused though Rule was issued in that case. Subsequently, mother of the Arif Khan filed a case under section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,1898 stating that his son Arif Khan was not the accused of Nari-O-Shishu Case No. 231 of 2004 and he was wrongly sent to jail as convict accused of that case. This petition filed by the mother of the said Arif Khan was registered as Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 25048 of 2014 upon which ad-interim bail was granted to Arif Khan for 6(six) months. But after expiry of the bail period it was not further extended by the learned Advocate appointed on behalf of the mother of the Arif Khan. In this way, on the self same matter, three miscellaneous cases are found pending before this court. At the time of long hearing of these three cases, we have perused all the relevant papers lying with the cases and asked local Officer in Charge of Singair Police Station, Manikgonj to submit a report regarding this unusual and unexpected matter. Accordingly, the Officer-in-Charge of Singair Police Station, Manikgonj bringing all relevant documents lying in his office appeared before this court and submitted a report prepared earlier by the then inspector of Singair Police Station named M.A. 1-toque wherein it was clearly stated that this petitioner Aynal Hoque by illegal means of gratification and giving false assurance of sending Arif Khan to Malaysia succeeded to manage him and accordingly this Arif Khan introducing himself as Aynal Haque, convict petitioner of the instant quashment petition surrendered before the Judge of the learned Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Daman Tribunal, Manikgonj upon which the quashment 

 Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 giving rise to another Miscellaneous Case No. 25048 of 

 2014 on the basis of which Arif Khan was allowed bail but that Misc. Case No. 25048 of 

 2014 and the concocted Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 filed at the instance of the 

 real convict petitioner of the instant quashment petition were not disposed of till now. That is why all the three cases are now pending before us. We have also directed the learned Advocate Mr. Abdul Mazid who conducted the Misc. Case No. 25048 of 2014 in favour of Arif Khan to appear before this court with a view to explain how he filed an application under section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898. But he could not satisfy us giving proper explanation about filing of' that case except submitting a mercy prayer with undertaking that he will never be involved in such type of illegal activities in future. At the same time learned Advocate Mr. Abdul Kader Bhuiyan who conducted the concocted and fabricated Miscellaneous case No. 2970 of 2014 in the same name of Aynal Haque, convict petitioner of this quashment petition, submitted a written statement praying for apology with the vow that he will never conduct such type of concocted cases without scrutinizing the papers that would be supplied to him by the real person or tadbirker of the cases. Considering the above facts and circumstances of the cases mentioned above, it has been crystal clear to us that this convict accused Aynal Haque got Aril Khan to surrender before the learned Judge of the Trial Court and after sending him to the jail custody Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 was filed by this convict petitioner Aynal Hoque who instigated Arif Khan to surrender before the Trial Court in place of him. However, since the learned Advocate Mr. Abdul Kadar Bhuivan and Mr. Abdul Majid appointed for Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 2970 of 2014 and 25048 of 2014 respectively are repented and solemnly affirmed that they would never commit such type of misdeeds in future, we have accepted their mercy petitions and accordingly, we strongly warned them to be more careful in receiving briefs from their respective clients  so that such type of misdeeds can not be committed by them in future. After giving opinion in details, Rules issued in both the two cases as mentioned above were discharged by us. 

 7. It has been established now that the instant convict petitioner Aynal Hoque being main accused of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Case No. 231 of 2014 committed all these evil deeds along with his other accomplices with a view to save his own skin only. As a result, it is manifestly seen that this convict accused Aynal Hoque committed rape on victim Tahmina @ Junaki a girl of 18 years old as a result of which the victim became conceived and lastly brought forth a female child who in the mean time has attained the age of 11 to 12 years. After committing such type of heinous offence, this convict petitioner filed two concocted case only for protecting him from punishment of the case. Because, if Arif Khan petitioner of Miscellaneous case No. 2970 of 2014 who surrendered before the learned Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Damon Tribunal, Manikgonj in the name of this convict accused petitioner had not been released by dint of the bail order passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 25048 of 2014 and if the concocted quashment petition filed by this real petitioner Aynal Hoque showing Arif Khan as petitioner of the earlier quashment petition giving rise to Misc. Case No.2970 of 2014 had been succeeded, there would not have been any scope of imposing punishment to the accused petitioner Aynal Hoque as real offender of this case. 

 8. It may be recorded here that at the time of hearing of this case Mr. Golam Kebria, the learned Advocate for the convict petitioner vehemently submitted that this accused Aynal Hoque is quite innocent and blamed the victim Jonaki to be a girl of immoral character. He further submits that the female child brought forth by the victim Jonaki has not yet been traced out. At one stage of his argument, lie filed a written application swearing supplementary affidavit that this convict petitioner Aynal Haque and female child of victim Jonaki had no blood cast connectivity for which he filed a petition for DNA test of victim Jonaki, her so called female child and this convict accused Aynal Haque. But when we put a question to him that where the existence of female child of victim Jonaki is not known to anybody as per his submission, how this DNA test would be conducted by the authority concerned in reply to which learned Advocate for the accused petitioner could not give any satisfactory answer to us. Unfortunately, when all these evil deeds committed by the convict accused Aynal Hauqe by fraudulent means have been detected by us, learned Advocate Mr. Golam Kibria filed a petition stating that he is desirous to obtain our consent as like as no objection certificate with a view to make him free from the liability of this case. After hearing the learned Advocate Mr. Golam Kibria, we have rejected his petition on the ground that after conclusion of hearing of three cases including the instant quashment petition, when the case is fixed for pronouncement of judgment, there is no reasonable ground to consider his petition positively. Moreover, we have also noticed that the application he submitted is not in form. 

 9. On the other hand Mr. 1-larun-or-Rashid, the learned Deputy Attorney General on behalf of the state submits that the convict accused Aynal Hoque being a veteran criminal should not he allowed to go unpunished with regard to the offences he committed by filing two false and fabricated criminal miscellaneous cases No. 2970 of 2014 and 25048 of 2014. Ile further submits that in fact to protect his own skin, this convict accused Aynal Hoque has got the mother of the Arif Khan to file a petition under section 491 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898. lie is the master mind of creating two concocted cases as mentioned above by unthinkable fraudulent means. He further submits that the accused Aynal Hoque having been failed to save his skin lastly filed the instant quashment petition being Miscellaneous Case No. 32688 of 2015 after his long absconsion surrendering before the Judge of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjaton Daman Tribunal, Manikgonj on 09.07.2015 long 11 years after the initiation of the case on 28.06.2004. 

 10. In the light of the above submission advanced by the learned Deputy Attorney General, we have perused the quashment petition and all other relevant papers appended thereto. On perusal of the record it appears that the convict accused Aynal Hoque having been failed to protect his own skin from the offence he committed, adopted all sorts of illegal activities and got Arif Khan and his mother to initiate Misc. Case No. 2970 of 2014 and Misc. Case No.25048 of 2014 by fraudulent means. As a result, we have directed the officer-in-charge of the concerned police station to start a regular case against the accused petitioner and his accomplices in course of disposing of the above noted fabricated cases. 

 11. In the light of the submission of the learned Advocates for both the sides, we have perused the original lower court's record and found that in total 10 P.Ws were examined in proof of the allegations brought against the convict accused petitioner. Among them P.W.1 is the mother of the victim Jonaki and P.W.9 is the victim Jonaki who stated in her evidence that convict accused Aynal Hoque committed rape on her as a result of which she became pregnant and gave birth a female child. The child is being brought up by another person who took the child as an adopted daughter. She disclosed the incident to her mother p.w.1 who informed the matter to the local witnesses. They tried to settle the matter amicably but failed due to the non cooperation of the convict accused petitioner and his relatives. The evidences of p.w.1 and victim P.W.9 were corroborated by local witnesses P.W.2,3,5,6 and P.W.7. stating in their evidence that they heard about the occurrence from P.W.1 and P.W.9 victim Jonaki who gave birth a female child due to the incident of rape committed on her by the convict accused petitioner Aynal Hoque. We do not find any discrepancies in the evidence of p.w.l-7 upon which we can disbelieve the prosecution case. Besides, p.w.4 is the doctor who alter examining the victim found her to be a girl of 18 years with pregnancy of 29 weeks which is very much consistent with the date of lodging First Information Report. P.W.8 is a formal witness of starting a regular case after receiving the 12.1.11 and P.W.10 is the Investigation Officer of the case. P.w.10 deposed that after concluding investigation having found pima-facie case he submitted charge sheet against the convict accused petitioner under section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, (as amended upto 2003) 2000. Though it has been submitted by the learned Advocate for the petitioner that as the Investigating Officer did not collect any alamat of the offence, it has become a case of no evidence. But we are not inclined to accept the above submission of the learned Advocate of the accused petitioner in that after the offence of rape committed by the accused petitioner, the victim Jonaki became pregnant and gave birth a female child who is being brought up in the harbour of another person as a living alamat of this case. In such view of the matter, there is no scope to state that it is a case of no evidence. Rather, it is manifestly seen that sufficient evidences were examined by the prosecution relying upon which learned Judge of the Tribunal rightly convicted this accused petitioner under section 9(1) of the Nari-O-Shishu N irjaton Daman Ain, 2000 and sentenced him to imprisonment for life with a fine of tk. 20,000/= in default to suffer 6 months imprisonment more. 

 12. In view of the discussion made above and considering the facts and circumstances of the case, we do not find any merit in this Rule. 

 14. Send down the L.C.R. lying with the criminal Miscellaneous case No. 2970 of 2014 along with a copy of this judgment to the concerned court at once for information and necessary action.
